title: A morphism of invertible modules whose zero scheme is an effective Cartier divisor $D$ gives $\mathcal N\cong\mathcal O_X(D)\otimes\mathcal M$
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal M,\mathcal N$ be invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module] and let $\varphi:\mathcal M\to\mathcal N$ be a morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Its *zero scheme* $Z(\varphi)\subseteq X$ is the closed subscheme whose ideal sheaf $\mathcal I_{Z(\varphi)}\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ is the image of the composite $\mathcal M\otimes\mathcal N^\vee\xrightarrow{\varphi\otimes1}\mathcal N\otimes\mathcal N^\vee\xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}}\mathcal O_X$; on an open $U$ on which $\mathcal M$ and $\mathcal N$ are free on generators $e_{\mathcal M},e_{\mathcal N}$ and $\varphi(e_{\mathcal M})=b\,e_{\mathcal N}$ with $b\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$, it is the ideal generated by $b$. (For $\mathcal M=\mathcal O_X$ and $\varphi=(f\mapsto fs)$ given by $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal N)$, $Z(\varphi)$ is the zero scheme $Z(s)$ of [def-pc-zero-scheme].) Assume that $\mathcal I_{Z(\varphi)}$ is an effective Cartier ideal [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal], so that $D:=Z(\varphi)$ is an effective Cartier divisor with associated invertible module $\mathcal O_X(D)=\mathcal I_D^\vee$ [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle]. Then there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules
$$
\mathcal N\cong \mathcal O_X(D)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal M .
$$
In particular, if $\mathcal L$ is an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module and $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L)$ is a section whose zero scheme $Z(s)$ is an effective Cartier divisor, then $\mathcal L\cong\mathcal O_X(Z(s))$.
